title: Jazz in European caves versus concert halls
summary: Sam is angered that black players accept playing in dumps in Europe and a writer saying jazz belongs in smoky joints.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: forth to Europe playing, I remember when you took Jazz music to Europe, you played in nothing but the finest concert halls. You go over there now and they've got you in them caves, when the war was on, them people had you down in them damn caves hiding from them bombs. That's where you're playing the music, in them dumps, the smoke-ass dumps.

....filthy-assed places, man, to play...playing jazz. They're playing, these stupid black players man don't have sense to detect what's happening man. You see they're trying to bring this music in the gutter, telling y ou that the music don't belong in the concert hall. I had a dude tell me that one time man, a writer.
That it didn't belong to the coneert?

To tell me that it didn't belong to the concert. It belonged in these real casual smoky joints. That's where the music sounds best at. And I almost punched the man in tthe mouth. They had to pull me away from him. The nerve of him to tell me.
There is a lot of them that believe that.

Because that's the way t hey are taking it, man. That's the way that the Black players is doing it. They come over and jump on the airplane, they send for you to take you to come over there, $700 a week. Is that worth $700 a week, man, to go ever there and to give away your culture like that,
just throw it away in the gutter man, in the slums.
